thresholds.freeze_rule: tau_conf/tau_px/tau_iou must be frozen on the validation set before any final read; this script never changes thresholds or labels

limitations: annotation-side GT_UNOBSERVABLE (undecidable / fully occluded without a visible box / ambiguous) is excluded from the presence fourfold and every denominator and reported separately; it is NOT a model failure
prediction-side UNKNOWN/REJECTED on GT-observable positives counts as a miss and is additionally listed by status and reject reason
anchor/bearing errors are image-domain quantities: 1 px is about 0.358 deg at fx=160 px for the 320x240 front camera; they are not world bearings, not ranges, and not ToF measurements
bbox IoU is a diagnostic (tau=0.3 is loose relative to the 0.649 blind re-annotation IoU) and is not part of the primary joint decision
a single-landmark experiment without similar-structure negatives cannot claim identity is evaluated
agent-proxy annotations are not expert or human independent review
no board deployment, navigation or Gate conclusion may be drawn here

denominator_audit.note: GT_UNOBSERVABLE (annotation state) and prediction UNKNOWN (model state) are separate buckets and are never merged
